name: a11y-audit
description: Use for any accessibility audit or a11y fix (WCAG 2.2 A/AA, color contrast, compliance report, CI check) in React, Next.js, Vue, Angular, Svelte or HTML. Scans with a11y_scanner.py and checks contrast with contrast_checker.py, then fixes and re-verifies.

name: ab-test-setup
description: Use before planning or launching any A/B, split or multivariate test, or when asked if a result is significant. Sizes the test with sample_size_calculator.py and writes the hypothesis, metric and stop rule first, so it is not called early on noise.

name: access-lifecycle
description: Use when preparing or running a user access review, checking that leavers lost their access, finding orphaned or ownerless service accounts, answering an auditor's access-control request for SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, HIPAA or NIST 800-53, or checking whether a finished review campaign will hold up. Diffs the HR roster against account exports, tests the campaign for coverage, self-review, unremoved revokes and rubber-stamping, and maps every exception to the controls it breaks.

name: ad-creative
description: Use for any ad copy request (RSA headlines, Meta, LinkedIn or TikTok ads, bulk variations), before writing. Checks every line against platform character limits and policy with ad_copy_validator.py. Campaign strategy and budgets: paid-ads.

name: adversarial-reviewer
description: Use before merging a PR or when a self-review feels too agreeable and the change needs a genuinely critical read. Reviews the diff through hostile reviewer personas that catch blind spots the author and a friendly reviewer share.

name: aeo
description: Use when content should be cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude or Gemini (answer engine optimization), before rewriting it. Scores E-E-A-T and structure with aeo_audit.py, rewrites with aeo_optimizer.py and logs citations with citation_tracker.py.

name: agent-decision-receipts
description: Use when an autonomous agent takes a side-effecting action (deploy, delete, pay, grant access) that may need proving later, or for EU AI Act Art. 12 record-keeping. Builds a tamper-evident signed receipt with build_action_manifest.py and verifies it.

name: agent-designer
description: Use when designing a multi-agent system (supervisor, swarm, pipeline), writing agent tool schemas, or reading agent run logs for cost, latency or failure bottlenecks. Not for Claude Code workflow files (workflow-builder).

name: agent-harness
description: Use when an agent should drive a goal in one of this repo's domains to a verified close, before starting the work. Compiles the goal into a task plan with goal_compiler.py and runs it through loop_controller.py, which verifies each task, caps retries and escalates.

name: agent-launcher-orchestrator
description: Use when someone wants to build, launch, grade or schedule a Claude Managed Agent in their own Anthropic account ('build me an agent', 'run this nightly'). Reads the session goal, routes with goal_router.py and compiles the loop with loop_compiler.py.

name: agent-memory
description: Use when an agent keeps relearning the same correction, CLAUDE.md has grown unreadable, or you need to trace where a remembered rule came from. Promotes facts through four tiers only on recurrence across sessions and days, with memory_promote.py and a human adopt step.

name: agent-protocol
description: Use when C-suite advisor agents need to call each other or run a multi-role meeting. Defines invocation syntax, loop prevention, isolation and response formats.

name: agent-regression-evals
description: Use before shipping any agent, prompt, model or tool change, or when a pass-rate drop needs a verdict. Runs repeated trials, gates candidate vs baseline with paired statistics in regression_gate.py, checks tool-call trajectories and finds flaky cases.

name: agent-workflow-designer
description: Use when architecting a multi-step LLM or agent pipeline, choosing single vs multi-agent, or fixing context bloat and broken handoffs. Scaffolds the pattern, handoff contracts and failure handling with workflow_scaffolder.py.

name: agenthub
description: Use when a task should be attempted by several agents in parallel and the best result kept (code speed, copy variants, research angles). Spawns N agents in git worktrees, ranks results by metric or judge with result_ranker.py and merges the winner.

name: agile-product-owner
description: Use for backlog work: writing user stories and acceptance criteria, splitting epics, estimating or prioritizing for a sprint. Generates stories with user_story_generator.py.

name: ai-act-readiness
description: Use for /compliance-os:ai-act-readiness, or EU AI Act readiness questions during AI-system intake or before EU deployment.

name: ai-decision-authority
description: Use before letting AI or an agent act on a marketing or GTM task without human review, or when writing an AI review policy. Places each workflow in AI-primary, collaborative or human-primary by stakes and reversibility.

name: ai-security
description: Use when assessing an AI/ML system or LLM agent for prompt injection, jailbreaks, model inversion, data poisoning or tool abuse. Maps findings to MITRE ATLAS and scores robustness with ai_threat_scanner.py.

name: aims-audit
description: Use for /compliance-os:aims-audit, or ISO 42001 readiness before stage 1 or an internal audit cycle.

name: analytics-tracking
description: Use for any GA4, Google Tag Manager, event-tracking or conversion-tracking setup, audit or broken-event debug, before touching tags. Generates the event taxonomy and tracking plan with tracking_plan_generator.py. Campaign performance analysis: campaign-analytics.

name: andreessen
description: Use when the user wants a blunt market-first verdict on an idea, venture or career bet ('is there a market', 'are we at PMF', 'pmarca mode'), or a 3x5-card daily plan. Scores with market_first_evaluator.py and pmf_signal_scorer.py; leads with the strongest counterargument.

name: api-design-reviewer
description: Use for any PR or spec that adds or changes REST endpoints, before approving it. Lints conventions with api_linter.py, detects breaking changes with breaking_change_detector.py and scores the design with api_scorecard.py.

name: api-test-suite-builder
description: Use when asked to write API, integration or contract tests for REST endpoints. Builds the suite from the routes: happy paths, auth, validation errors and edge cases per endpoint.

name: app-store-optimization
description: Use for any App Store or Google Play listing, keyword, ranking or review question, before writing metadata. Scores the listing with aso_scorer.py and checks keywords, competitors, title and subtitle limits and reviews with its 8 ASO scripts.

name: apple-hig-expert
description: Use when designing or reviewing iOS, macOS, watchOS or visionOS UI against Apple's Human Interface Guidelines, including Liquid Glass, contrast and tap targets. Checks it with hig_checker.py.

name: ar-loop
description: Use for /ar-loop, or to run an autoresearch experiment on a schedule (10 min to monthly) with CronCreate.

name: ar-resume
description: Use for /ar-resume, or to continue a paused autoresearch experiment from its branch and results history.

name: ar-run
description: Use for /ar-run, or to run one manual autoresearch iteration: edit, evaluate, keep or discard.

name: ar-status
description: Use for /ar-status, or to see an autoresearch experiment's results, active loops and progress.

name: arquiteto-de-empresa
description: Use when a founder wants to document or design a whole company as version-controlled markdown (company as code, a company wiki agents can read, an OKF bundle). Runs a 12-phase interview, scaffolds with scaffold_bundle.py and checks it with okf_linter.py.

name: atlassian-admin
description: Use for Atlassian org administration: Jira or Confluence users and groups, permissions, SSO, marketplace apps or security policy. Audits permissions with permission_audit_tool.py.

name: atlassian-templates
description: Use when creating or changing Jira or Confluence templates, blueprints or page layouts for reuse across the org. Scaffolds them with template_scaffolder.py.

name: autoresearch-agent
description: Use when a file should be improved against a measurable metric (speed, bundle size, pass rate, prompt or headline score), before hand-tuning it. Loops edit, run_experiment.py, keep or git reset on a fixed evaluator; needs an eval command and a git repo.

name: aws-solution-architect
description: Use when designing or costing an AWS architecture (serverless, Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, ECS, Aurora, CloudFormation, migration to AWS). Designs it with architecture_designer.py, generates stacks with serverless_stack.py and finds savings with cost_optimizer.py.

name: azure-cloud-architect
description: Use when designing or costing an Azure architecture (AKS, App Service, Functions, Cosmos DB, Bicep or ARM, Azure DevOps, migration to Azure). Designs it with architecture_designer.py, generates Bicep with bicep_generator.py and finds savings with cost_optimizer.py.

name: behuman
description: Use when the user asks for less robotic, more human replies ('be real', 'talk like a person', 'mirror mode'), or the conversation is emotionally heavy (grief, job loss, fear). Drops lists and hedging for a direct, warm voice. Not for code or factual lookups.

name: board
description: Use to post or read messages on the AgentHub coordination board between competing agents.

name: board-deck-builder
description: Use when building a board deck, investor update or QBR from all C-suite perspectives. Structures the narrative and how to deliver bad news.

name: board-meeting
description: Use for /c-level-agents:boardroom or a strategic question that needs a structured multi-executive deliberation. Runs six phases: context, isolated C-suite views, critic, synthesis, founder review and decision.

name: board-prep
description: Use before a board meeting, investor update or fundraising pitch where the numbers will be challenged. Drills numbers cold, anticipates the hard questions and builds a narrative that admits weakness without losing the room.

name: boardroom
description: Use for /c-level-agents:boardroom, or a decision spanning several executive domains (a pricing change, raise vs cut). Runs a 6-phase C-suite deliberation and writes a board memo.

name: book-to-skill
description: Use when turning a book, docs folder or spec collection (PDF, EPUB, DOCX, HTML, Markdown) into an agent skill, before summarizing it by hand. Extracts with extract_document.py, compiles chapters, glossary and cheatsheet, validates with book_skill_validator.py and enforces a rights gate.

name: boost-asio-pro
description: Use for any C++ networking code with Boost.Asio or standalone Asio (TCP/UDP, SSL, timers, strands, io_context, co_spawn, awaitable, completion handlers), before writing or reviewing it. Applies lifetime, strand and cancellation rules that avoid the classic async bugs.

name: brand-guidelines

name: brief
description: Use for /c-level-agents:brief, or to frame a strategic question (options, assumptions, success criteria) as a one-page brief before deliberation.

name: browser-automation
description: Use for browser automation, scraping, form filling or structured extraction from web pages. Builds scrapers with scraping_toolkit.py and form flows with form_automation_builder.py. Browser testing: playwright-pro.

name: browserstack
description: Use when running Playwright tests on BrowserStack or across a browser matrix ('browserstack', 'cross-browser', 'test on safari or firefox', 'browser compatibility').

description: Use when deciding whether a capital expense is worth it (equipment, property, an acquisition, hiring, technology), or for ROI, IRR, NPV, payback, build vs buy or lease vs buy.

name: business-name-fit
description: Use when naming a company, brand or product, or checking whether a name works abroad, before committing to one. Tests a culturally rooted name for pronunciation, bad meanings and trust in each target market, and suggests alternatives.

name: business-operations-skills
description: Use when an internal operations request needs routing (process, vendors, capacity, internal comms, SOPs, procurement): 'where's the bottleneck', 'vendor health'. Lists the BizOps skills and routes to one.

name: capa-officer
description: Use for CAPA work in a medical device QMS: root cause analysis (5-Why, fishbone), corrective action plans, effectiveness checks or CAPA metrics. Tracks CAPAs with capa_tracker.py and analyzes causes with root_cause_analyzer.py.

name: capacity-planner
description: Use when sizing an ops or support team, building a headcount plan or checking utilization risk. Models queues with Erlang C in capacity_modeler.py, analyzes utilization with utilization_analyzer.py and orders hires with hiring_sequencer.py.

name: capture
description: Use whenever the user unloads a messy brain dump of ideas, tasks and plans ('capture this', 'brain dump', a long unstructured paste) and wants it organized. Sorts it with dump_classifier.py into projects, tasks and connections with nothing lost.

name: caveman
description: > Ultra-compressed communication mode. Cuts token usage ~75% by dropping filler, articles, and pleasantries while keeping full technical accuracy. Use when user says "caveman mode", "talk like caveman", "use caveman", "less tokens", "be brief", or invokes /caveman.

name: cco-review
description: Use for /c-level-agents:cco-review, or to challenge a plan touching retention, segmentation or CS headcount.

name: cdo-review
description: Use for /c-level-agents:cdo-review, or to challenge a plan touching training-data rights, data architecture or data monetization.

name: ceo-advisor
description: Use for CEO-level questions: company strategy, board and investor management, fundraising, org design or culture. Models scenarios with financial_scenario_analyzer.py and strategy with strategy_analyzer.py.

name: cfo-advisor
description: Use for startup finance decisions: unit economics (LTV, CAC), burn and runway, fundraising and dilution, or board financials. Runs unit_economics_analyzer.py, burn_rate_calculator.py and fundraising_model.py.

name: cfo-review
description: Use for /c-level-agents:cfo-review, or to challenge a plan that commits real money (a hiring wave, a raise, a channel budget).

name: challenge
description: Use before committing serious resources to a plan, or when feedback has been suspiciously positive. Runs a pre-mortem: assume it failed in 12 months and work back to the assumptions, dependencies and execution risks.

name: change-management
description: Use when rolling out a reorg, pivot, tool switch, leadership change or product kill. Plans it with ADKAR, communication templates and resistance patterns.

name: changelog-generator
description: Use when cutting a release, writing CHANGELOG.md or deciding the next version from commits, before writing notes by hand. Lints commits with commit_linter.py, picks the semver bump with version_bumper.py and renders notes with generate_changelog.py.

name: channel-economics
description: Use for a direct vs partner channel review: fully loaded cost to serve, channel ROI and the best channel mix under constraints. Runs cost_to_serve_calculator.py, channel_roi_analyzer.py and channel_mix_optimizer.py.

name: chaos-engineering
description: Use before running a chaos experiment, gameday or fault injection, or after one to write it up. Designs it with steady state and abort criteria in experiment_designer.py, sizes the blast radius with blast_radius_calculator.py and drafts the postmortem.

name: chief-ai-officer-advisor
description: Use for AI strategy decisions: API vs fine-tune vs build, EU AI Act or US state risk classification, when self-hosting pays off, or AI hiring order. Runs model_buildvsbuy_calculator.py, ai_risk_classifier.py and ai_cost_economics.py.

name: chief-customer-officer-advisor
description: Use for retention strategy, customer segmentation or CS team sizing decisions (GRR vs NRR, churn causes, pooled vs named CSMs). Runs retention_decomposition_analyzer.py, customer_segmentation_designer.py and cs_coverage_calculator.py.

name: chief-data-officer-advisor
description: Use for data strategy decisions: training models on customer data, warehouse vs lakehouse vs mesh, valuing data for a raise or M&A, or data hiring order. Runs ai_training_data_audit.py, data_product_strategy_picker.py and data_asset_valuator.py.

name: chief-of-staff
description: Use when a founder question needs routing to the right C-suite advisor, or a cross-functional decision needs a board meeting convened. Loads company context, synthesizes the answers and tracks decisions.

name: chro-advisor
description: Use for people strategy: hiring plans, comp bands, org structure, performance or retention. Models hiring with hiring_plan_modeler.py and benchmarks pay with comp_benchmarker.py.

name: churn-prevention
description: Use when designing a cancel flow, save offers, exit surveys or dunning emails, or cutting failed-payment churn. Sizes the revenue at stake with churn_impact_calculator.py first. Health scores and expansion: customer-success-manager.

name: ci-cd-pipeline-builder
description: Use when setting up or refactoring CI/CD for a repo, before writing workflow YAML. Detects the stack with stack_detector.py and generates the pipeline with pipeline_generator.py.

name: ciso-advisor
description: Use for security leadership decisions: a security program, budget justification in dollars, SOC 2 vs ISO 27001 vs HIPAA roadmap, or board security reporting. Quantifies risk with risk_quantifier.py and tracks compliance with compliance_tracker.py.

name: ciso-review
description: Use for /c-level-agents:ciso-review, or to challenge a plan touching customer data, compliance or production access.

name: claude-coach
description: Use when the user wants to get better at using Claude ('coach me', 'teach me Claude tricks', 'make me a power user'). Rates their prompts with prompt_rater.py and surfaces one relevant power-user tip per turn after activation.

name: clinical-research
description: Use when designing a prospective clinical study: choosing primary and secondary endpoints, estimating sample size and power, or scoring feasibility before submission. Runs endpoint_selector.py, sample_size_estimator.py and phase_gate_scorer.py; outputs are estimates for a biostatistician to confirm.

name: cloud-security
description: Use when checking AWS, Azure or GCP for security misconfigurations: IAM privilege escalation, public buckets, open security groups, IaC gaps. Runs cloud_posture_check.py and maps findings to MITRE ATT&CK.

name: cmmc-readiness
description: Use when a defense contractor or subcontractor is preparing for a CMMC 2.0 Level 2 self-assessment or C3PAO assessment, calculating or checking an SPRS score against NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2, deciding what can go on a POA&M, tracking POA&M closeout before Conditional status expires, or scoping assets, enclaves and cloud providers that handle CUI. Scores all 110 requirements with the 32 CFR 170.24 weights, blocks gaps that can never be deferred, and classifies the asset inventory into CMMC asset categories.

name: cmo-advisor
description: Use for marketing leadership decisions: positioning, PLG vs sales-led vs community-led, budget allocation or marketing team design. Simulates growth with growth_model_simulator.py and budgets with marketing_budget_modeler.py.

name: cmo-review
description: Use for /c-level-agents:cmo-review, or to challenge positioning, ICP, messaging or channel mix before a launch.

name: code-reviewer

Applies per-language rule packs (security such as SQL injection and missing auth, async and resource handling, error handling, performance) and scripts that score a PR's risk and complexity, then gives a merge verdict with blocking and non-blocking findings. name: code-to-prd
description: Use when asked to write a PRD or product spec from an existing codebase (reverse-engineer requirements, document pages, fields, routes and endpoints). Maps the code with codebase_analyzer.py and scaffolds the PRD with prd_scaffolder.py.

name: code-tour

name: collab-proof

Forecasts with bookings_forecaster.py, projects cohorts with cohort_arr_projector.py and scores stage confidence with funnel_confidence_scorer.py, showing every conversion assumption.

name: commercial-policy
description: Use when writing or revising discount rules: discount matrix, approver thresholds, exception flows and the deal framework sales works under. Builds the matrix with discount_matrix_builder.py, routes exceptions with exception_router.py and checks the policy with policy_linter.py.

name: commercial-skills
description: Use when a commercial request needs routing (pricing, deal review, discounts, partners, channels, policy, RFPs, forecasts): 'review this deal', 'should we discount'. Lists the commercial skills and routes to one.

name: company-os

description: Use for competitor analysis, battlecards, win/loss review or positioning against alternatives. Builds a tracking system that feeds positioning, sales and roadmap.

name: compliance-readiness
description: Use for /compliance-os:compliance-readiness, or before adding a framework or planning the annual audit calendar.

description: Use for any blog post, article or guide to write end to end, before drafting. Runs research, outline, draft and SEO passes, then gates the piece with content_scorer.py, seo_optimizer.py and content_quality_gates.py.

description: Use when planning, promoting or fixing a webinar or virtual event (registrations, show-up, follow-up, conversion). Scores each funnel stage with webinar_funnel_scorer.py to find where it leaks.

name: weekly-review
description: Use when someone wants to run a weekly review, close open loops, audit stalled projects and commitments, get their system back to trusted, restart a lapsed review habit, or says "/cs-weekly-review". Walks David Allen's three-phase loop — GET CLEAR, GET CURRENT, GET CREATIVE — with deterministic scripts that inventory open loops, gate the checklist with named gaps, and score commitment health 0-100.

name: workflow-builder
description: Use when writing or running a Claude Code Workflow-tool script (.js in .claude/workflows/) for fan-out, pipeline, loop or judge-panel sub-agents. Gathers intent with workflow_intake.py, scaffolds with scaffold_workflow.py and validates with validate_workflow.py.

name: wrap-up
description: Use when closing out a launched managed agent ('wrap up', 'what do I own now'). Inventories primitives with primitives_inventory.py, regenerates the overview with overview_page.py and suggests next upgrades with upgrade_suggester.py.

name: write-a-skill
description: Create new agent skills with proper structure, progressive disclosure, and bundled resources. Use when user wants to create, write, build, or author a new skill.

name: x-twitter-growth
description: Use for growing on X/Twitter: tweets, threads, profile audit, competitors or posting plan. Audits the profile with profile_auditor.py, drafts with tweet_composer.py and plans posts with content_planner.py.

name: youtube-full
description: Use for any YouTube URL, video ID or @handle, or a request for transcripts, video search, channel, playlist or new-upload monitoring. Fetches them with yt-dlp, youtube-transcript-api and public RSS feeds, with no API key; no video or audio downloads.

name: zero-hallucination-coder
description: Use before high-stakes or multi-file coding (auth, databases, migrations), or when asked to plan carefully and avoid invented APIs. Runs discuss, map, decompose, execute and verify, checking every import and API exists. Not for trivial edits.
